topbar.search: Search clients, people or run an action…

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage your UniFi network
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts, try again later

setup.title: Welcome to Unifire
setup.subtitle: A few minutes to unlock what UniFi can’t do

admin.title: Create the administrator
admin.desc: This is a Unifire account, separate from UniFi.

controller.title: Connect to your UniFi console
controller.desc: Unifire uses the UniFi internal API with a local admin account.
controller.accountTipBody: In UniFi OS create a local-only account (e.g. “unifire”) without MFA and with Network admin rights, so it can be audited and revoked.
controller.urlHint: Your UDM / UCG IP or hostname (https)
controller.certVerify: Verify this is your console’s certificate
controller.subject: Subject
controller.certCompare: Compare the fingerprint in UniFi OS → Settings → Console. If it ever changes, Unifire refuses to connect.
controller.insecureWarn: Skipping verification exposes credentials to MITM attacks

review.selfNotFound: Own MAC not found; set it later in Settings
review.dryRunNote: Observe first, switch to live when confident

done.title: You’re all set!
done.desc: Unifire is syncing your network. Next you can:

protect.title: Which routes must Unifire never touch?
protect.desc: Tick routes Unifire must only ever read. They can’t be adopted either; you can change this later in Settings → General.
protect.hint: You can change this later in Settings → General → Never-touch routes.

pwa.installBody: Add to your home screen for an app-like experience and push alerts.
pwa.updateBody: Reload to use the latest Unifire.
pwa.iosHint: In Safari tap Share → “Add to Home Screen” to install and receive notifications.

dashboard.title: Network overview
dashboard.constellationHint: Who goes out through which route and exit
dashboard.noRoutesDesc: Create your first scheduled route to light up the constellation.
dashboard.noUpcoming: No switches in the next 24 hours

routes.desc: Switch a device’s WAN / VPN exit by schedule, health or on demand — something UniFi can’t do natively.
routes.emptyDesc: Create a new route or adopt an existing UniFi route.
routes.name: Name
routes.ownershipHint: Only Unifire-managed routes are ever written
routes.adoptHint: After adopting, Unifire may change this route’s exit; source, destination and kill switch are watched and management pauses if someone edits them in UniFi.
routes.suspectedAutomationHint: Audit saw this route’s egress being changed from outside recently (likely another script). Stop that script before adopting, or the two will keep overwriting each other.
routes.adoptAutomationAck: I have stopped the outside script that changes this route
routes.killSwitchHint: Block traffic when the exit is down instead of falling back
routes.defaultEgressHint: Used for hours left blank in the schedule
routes.releaseDesc: Unifire will stop changing this route; UniFi keeps its current config.
routes.releaseDelete: Also delete the route from UniFi
routes.releaseDeleteHint: Only for routes created by Unifire
routes.driftTitle: This route was changed in UniFi
routes.driftDesc: To avoid fighting over it, Unifire paused management. Accept the current config to resume.
routes.scheduleSaved: Schedule saved; applies at the top of the hour
routes.paintHint: Drag to paint · 1–9 pick brush · ⌘Z undo

gen.title: Rotation generator
gen.desc: Pin hours and define a rotation to fill the whole week.
gen.cycleHint: Unpinned hours cycle through these exits in order; repeats allowed.
gen.cycleEmpty: Tap an exit below to add it
gen.preset: Preset: WAN at midnight, rotate VPNs
gen.dailyResetHint: Each day starts from the first exit

failover.enableHint: When the primary exit fails probes, move to the first healthy fallback and switch back once stable.
failover.lossHint: Loss above this counts as failure
failover.recoverHint: How long the primary must stay healthy

routes.dryRunCreatedDesc: Unifire is in dry-run mode, so UniFi was not changed. Switch to live mode to create it.
routes.dryRunReleasedDesc: In dry-run the delete is only evaluated; the route stays in UniFi and managed.

egresses.desc: Live health, latency and real public IP of every WAN and VPN client.
egresses.sweepRunning: Rotating the probe route through each exit…
egresses.emptyDesc: WANs and VPN clients appear once UniFi is connected.
egresses.probeEnableHint: Create a dedicated probe route (Unifire host only) to measure this exit

clients.desc: Every device that has joined your network — assign, block or inspect usage.
clients.name: Client

people.desc: Group devices by person to pause, set bedtimes and quotas per person.
people.emptyDesc: Add family members and assign their devices.
people.name: Name
people.devicesHint: Pause & quotas apply to all of them
people.bedtimeHint: Internet pauses automatically in these windows

approvals.desc: New devices land here — approve, ignore or block them.
approvals.swipeHint: Swipe right to approve, left to block
approvals.emptyDesc: You’ll get a push notification when one shows up.

quotas.desc: Count active minutes or data; block or reroute when the limit is hit.
quotas.emptyDesc: e.g. kids: 2 h on school days, 4 h on weekends.
quotas.name: Name
quotas.activeHint: Only minutes with real traffic count; simultaneous devices of one person count once.

actionHint.block: Pause all devices until the next period or an approved extension
actionHint.egress: e.g. move to a slower WAN

rules.desc: Chain UniFi events into automations: switch exits on arrival, alert when a VPN drops, push on new devices…
rules.emptyDesc: Start from a template or build your own.

welcomeHome.title: Tell Home Assistant when someone arrives

vpnDownNotify.title: VPN down alert
vpnDownNotify.desc: Push when any exit goes down

newDeviceTelegram.title: New device alert
newDeviceTelegram.desc: Notify when an unknown device joins

rules.noConditions: No conditions — runs on every trigger
rules.name: Rule name
rules.testDesc: Run the actions once with a synthetic event.
rules.cronHint: cron: min hour day month weekday
rules.allChannelsIfEmpty: Leave empty for all enabled channels

watchdogs.desc: Ping PoE devices (cameras, APs…) and power-cycle their switch port after repeated failures.
watchdogs.emptyDesc: A camera that hangs? Let Unifire reboot it automatically.
watchdogs.targetHint: Pick a wired client to auto-fill IP and port
watchdogs.name: Name
watchdogs.poePortHint: Uplinks and non-PoE ports are excluded
watchdogs.summary: After {n} misses (~{s}s) the port is power-cycled, then cools down {c} min; at most {m} times a day.

guestWifi.desc: Rotate the guest Wi-Fi password automatically and show a QR code on a tablet.
guestWifi.autoRotateHint: Generate a new password on schedule and apply it to UniFi

styleHint.words: e.g. sunny-tiger-42 — easy to read aloud

guestWifi.rotateConfirm: Connected guests will need the new password. Continue?

kiosk.scan: Scan with your phone camera to join
kiosk.invalid: This kiosk link is no longer valid

wol.desc: Wake a NAS or PC on schedule or from a rule.

wol.emptyDesc: Add a NAS or PC to wake remotely.
wol.name: Name
wol.broadcastHint: Leave empty to derive from the subnet

snapshots.desc: Back up routes, firewall, objects, networks and Wi-Fi; diff like git and restore item by item.
snapshots.identicalDesc: No differences between the two points.

controller.liveDesc: Schedules, failover and rules really change UniFi.

controller.capsDesc: Which APIs this controller version supports

probes.title: [unifire-probe] routes
probes.desc: One route per exit, source is only the Unifire host, destination a dedicated probe IP, kill switch on — so a dead exit always fails the probe.
probes.cleanupDesc: Health probing and failover will stop working.
probes.poolHint: One public IP per line, assigned to exits in order; avoid the DNS your host uses.
